name: Outlit
long_description:
Outlit helps B2B SaaS companies improve GRR and NRR by keeping more customers and finding more expansion revenue.

Outlit creates a real-time view of every customer using product usage, support, calls, email, Slack, billing, CRM, and external signals. It assesses whether each account is likely to renew, expand, contract, or churn, then provides the evidence and next action.

The result: stronger adoption, higher retention, and more expansion revenue from signals your team would never catch in a health score or any single tool.

launches.title: Outlit - The Future of Deal Making
launches.tagline: Turn historical deal insights into better, more profitable deals.
launches.body:
**TL;DR** \
\
Outlit is building the future of enterprise deal-making by helping Deal Desk and Revenue teams close better deals faster. \
\
We leverage companies' historical terms, pricing, clauses, and redlines to automate deal reviews based on what's worked in the past and surface upsell, cross-sell, and renewal potential through your new and legacy customers contracts.\
\
<https://youtu.be/CVaiaDscToM>

**The Problem** \
B2B Enterprises lose up to 40% of deals during the proposal, negotiation, and closing phases of sales cycles. This happens because:

Sales teams are incentivized to close deals quickly, while Deal Desk teams must ensure agreements benefit the entire organization. 

This creates a fundamental tension: move too fast, and poor deal hygiene leads to costly mistakes; move too slowly, and competitors steal deals before they're finalized.

\
**The Solution** \
Outlit eliminates the trade-off between speed and accuracy—while increasing deal size. \
\
We turn your entire deal history into an AI-powered playbook that guides reps and Deal Desk in structuring, pricing, and reviewing deals.

With Outlit, teams:

* Close deals faster without sacrificing accuracy
* Identify upsell, cross-sell, and price optimization opportunities
* Reduce approval cycles and eliminate contract bottlenecks

\
**How It Works**

1. We analyze your historical contracts and order forms, transforming them into a dynamic knowledge base that understands previous decisions and failed and successful deal patterns.
2. When creating or reviewing deals, Outlit provides historical AI-driven insights on optimal terms, pricing, and clauses—helping teams craft stronger agreements faster.
3. By uncovering insights from past deals, Outlit identifies hidden opportunities for renewals, upsells, cross-sells, and price optimizations—turning legacy agreements into new revenue streams.

**Our Team** \
